| `work_context` | `void *`                       | dispatch work context supplied by Entasis                                                      |

### `entasis_velocity_callbacks_t`

copied custom integration table. caller context remains borrowed

all four function pointers are required. conflicts with an explicitly selected legacy pose policy are rejected. a failed initialize callback must clean up its own partial resources. dispose is called only after initialization succeeds

Size `56`, alignment `8`

| Field                              | C type                               | Meaning                                                           |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `struct_size`                      | `uint32_t`                           | initialize to sizeof this structure                               |
| `struct_version`                   | `uint32_t`                           | initialize to 1                                                   |
| `angular_mode`                     | `entasis_angular_integration_mode_t` | existing angular integration policy                               |
| `allow_substeps_for_unconstrained` | `entasis_bool_t`                     | whether unconstrained bodies use substeps                         |
| `integrate_kinematic_velocity`     | `entasis_bool_t`                     | whether kinematic velocity is passed through integration          |
| `_reserved0`                       | `uint8_t`                            | initialize reserved storage to zero                               |
| `user_context`                     | `void *`                             | caller-owned callback state, borrowed for the registered lifetime |
| `initialize`                       | `entasis_velocity_initialize_fn`     | required initialization callback                                  |
| `prepare`                          | `entasis_velocity_prepare_fn`        | required preparation callback                                     |
| `integrate`                        | `entasis_velocity_integrate_fn`      | required eight-lane callback                                      |
| `dispose`                          | `entasis_velocity_dispose_fn`        | required callback resource disposal                               |

### `entasis_contact_callbacks_t`

copied custom narrow-phase table with borrowed caller context

all callbacks except select_constraint are required. they may run on multiple workers and must not reenter world mutation. conflicts with explicit built-in narrow policies are rejected. views expire on return. failed initialization owns its partial cleanup. successful initialization receives one disposal

| `user_context`      | `void *`                               | caller-owned callback state, borrowed for the registered lifetime |
| `initialize`        | `entasis_contact_initialize_fn`        | required initialization callback                                  |
| `allow`             | `entasis_contact_allow_fn`             | required pair filter                                              |
| `allow_child`       | `entasis_contact_allow_child_fn`       | required child-pair filter                                        |
| `configure`         | `entasis_contact_configure_fn`         | required manifold and material callback                           |
| `configure_child`   | `entasis_contact_configure_child_fn`   | required child-manifold callback                                  |
| `dispose`           | `entasis_contact_dispose_fn`           | required disposal callback                                        |
| `select_constraint` | `entasis_contact_select_constraint_fn` | optional compatible contact-constraint selection                  |

### `entasis_step_scope_t`

borrowed value token valid only within one custom timestep callback

a copied token is rejected after its invocation expires while the world remains alive. it owns no stack memory. use after world destruction violates the normal handle lifetime contract. recursive scope operations are rejected

### `entasis_world_extensions_t`

additive initialization options. a null table retains the existing native path

initialize with entasis_world_extensions_default. descriptors are copied, but user contexts and application arrays remain borrowed for their documented lifetime. malformed selected tables and conflicting explicit convenience policies fail before initialization callbacks run. Legacy allocator reach remains unchanged. All_Owned routes all owned world/pool/worker/query and extension storage through the selected allocator, preserving independent borrowed resource owners

allocation: none. thread safety: owner thread only

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_world_stats(const entasis_world_t * world, entasis_world_stats_t * out_stats, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                    | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `const entasis_world_t *` | target world                                                                 |
| `out_stats`  | `entasis_world_stats_t *` | receives the world stats                                                     |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`  | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_world_destroy`

destroys one world and every C-ABI-owned adapter resource

it never disposes an external pool or external dispatcher. a destroyed world may be initialized again

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_world_begin_read`

begins an immutable-world read phase

owner-thread operation, not a lock. the application must publish jobs only after begin_read and join every reader before end_read. mutation, stepping, registration, capacity changes, import and destruction are rejected during this phase. query contexts require independent outputs and callback user data safe for concurrent reads

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_world_begin_read(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                   | Meaning                                                              |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `entasis_world_t *`      | live world kept at a stable address until every context is destroyed |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *` | optional caller-exclusive diagnostic output                          |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_world_end_read`

ends a read phase after the caller joins every read job

owner-thread operation, not a lock. the application must publish jobs only after begin_read and join every reader before end_read. mutation, stepping, registration, capacity changes, import and destruction are rejected during this phase. query contexts require independent outputs and callback user data safe for concurrent reads

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_world_end_read(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                   | Meaning                                                              |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `entasis_world_t *`      | live world kept at a stable address until every context is destroyed |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *` | optional caller-exclusive diagnostic output                          |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_world_init_extended`

initializes a world with optional custom callbacks and timestep hooks

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_world_init_extended(entasis_world_t * world, const entasis_world_description_t * description, const entasis_world_extensions_t * extensions, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter     | C type                                | Meaning                                                                         |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`       | `entasis_world_t *`                   | caller-owned world handle initialized to zero                                   |
| `description` | `const entasis_world_description_t *` | existing world configuration and sole allocator authority                       |
| `extensions`  | `const entasis_world_extensions_t *`  | optional copied initialization extensions. NULL preserves the existing behavior |
| `diagnostic`  | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`              | optional output diagnostic                                                      |

returns the operation status. completed work is not rolled back on callback failure

### `entasis_world_init_with_pool_extended`

initializes a world with borrowed storage and optional extensions

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_world_init_with_pool_extended(entasis_world_t * world, const entasis_world_description_t * description, entasis_buffer_pool_t * pool, const entasis_world_extensions_t * extensions, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter     | C type                                | Meaning                                                                         |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`       | `entasis_world_t *`                   | caller-owned world handle initialized to zero                                   |
| `description` | `const entasis_world_description_t *` | existing world configuration and sole allocator authority                       |
| `pool`        | `entasis_buffer_pool_t *`             | borrowed independently initialized pool, not attached to a query context        |

returns the operation status. completed work is not rolled back on callback failure

### `entasis_world_stage_sleep`

executes only the sleep stage on an idle world

does not increment the completed-step counter or automatically report timestep completion. existing native stage order requirements and view invalidation apply. callback reentry and calls during a read phase are rejected

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_world_stage_sleep(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                   | Meaning                               |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `entasis_world_t *`      | caller-owned initialized world handle |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *` | optional output diagnostic            |

returns the operation status. completed work is not rolled back on callback failure

### `entasis_step_scope_sleep`

executes the sleep stage within the selected custom timestep

uses the current dispatcher without reentering world_step. scope operations cannot execute recursively and do not increment the step counter

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_step_scope_sleep(entasis_step_scope_t scope, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                   | Meaning                            |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| `scope`      | `entasis_step_scope_t`   | current live custom timestep scope |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *` | optional output diagnostic         |

returns the operation status. completed work is not rolled back on callback failure

### `entasis_step_scope_report_completion`

reports a completion point chosen by the custom timestepper

scope stages do not emit completion hooks implicitly. reports invoke the existing completion callback and profiler stage. callback errors propagate without rollback

```c

```

| Parameter    | C type                                | Meaning                            |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `scope`      | `entasis_step_scope_t`                | current live custom timestep scope |
| `stage`      | `entasis_timestep_completion_stage_t` | completed stage identifier         |
| `dt`         | `float`                               | positive duration in seconds       |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`              | optional output diagnostic         |

returns the operation status. completed work is not rolled back on callback failure
